title: Saiyans: Battle Power and forms
text: A Saiyan has Battle Power (BP), starting at 100 and gained by kills, never by farming: weak foes (under 25% of your BP) and young mobs give nothing, repeats of one creature pay less, and a day pays at most the larger of 20 or 10% of your BP. Ranks: Low-Class 100, Elite 1,000, Super Elite 10,000, Legendary 100,000, Divine 1,000,000, Transcendent 10,000,000 (setting max is 1 billion by default). There are 16 transformations plus Base, 17 in all: Kaio-ken, False Super Saiyan, Super Saiyan, Full Power, Super Saiyan 2 and 3 (Battle Power from 3,000 up to 400,000), then Super Saiyan 4, Full Power SS4 and the Limit Breaker, Super Saiyan God, Blue, Perfected Blue, Blue Kaio-ken, and the Ultra Instinct line (Sign, Perfected, True, up to 10,000,000 BP). The ten from SS4 on need the Goku awakening, which asks for 100,000 BP. Each form needs Battle Power, Zenkai (a near-death comeback), training and mastery of its parent form; a new form works at 85% strength and a mastered one at 100%. /saiyan forms shows what you have and what is missing. Every number is a server setting (nusmp-saiyan-server.toml).
